basic_details.job_title: District Health Society, Thiruvarur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 59 Posts
basic_details.application_mode: Offline (in person, registered post, speed post or courier)
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Thiruvarur is filling Staff Nurse posts on a contractual, temporary basis under the NHM scheme in Thiruvarur district. The notice carries an application form for the post on its later pages. The official notification does not specify the application fee, the selection process or the notification date.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and lists no age relaxation.

qualification.education_qualification: D.G.N.M. / B.Sc. Nursing with valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration
qualification.details: The application form also asks for the name of the institution, the council registration number, SSLC and HSC (+2) marks and the percentage obtained in the qualifying exam (GNM / B.Sc.). Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

salary_details.details: The notice mentions no allowances on top of this consolidated pay.

how_to_apply: Take the application form for the post of Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse, printed in the notice under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu and the District Health Society, Thiruvarur heading.

Enter the details asked: name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, qualification, institution, council registration number, addresses, Aadhar number, phone number, email ID (if available) and community.
Fill in the SSLC and HSC (+2) marks, the percentage in the qualifying exam, and the district(s) applied for (maximum 3).
Answer whether you are differently abled, and whether you are a transgender person, deserted wife, ex-serviceman or destitute widow.
Affix a passport size photograph and sign the declaration with place and date.
Attach the certificates that support the details given in the form.
Send the application to: The Executive Secretary, District Health Society and District Health Office, Old Government Hospital Campus, Netty Velaikkarar Street, Thiruvarur-610001.
Applications may be given in person or sent by registered post, speed post or courier, to reach by 5:00 PM on 04.12.2026.
important_instructions: The post is entirely temporary and on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu. The post will not be made permanent at any time, and services will not be regularised for any reason. The declaration on the form states that the applicant is aware of this and that the information given is true and correct. Applications received after 5:00 PM on 04.12.2026 will not be accepted. The number of posts is subject to change.

content_sections.heading: About District Health Society Thiruvarur
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Thiruvarur works under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu. Its notice is issued by the Executive Secretary, with the District Health Officer's office at the Old Government Hospital Campus, Netty Velaikkarar Street, Thiruvarur. The notice is signed for the Chairman of the District Health Society, who is the District Collector, Thiruvarur.

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Thiruvarur Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice says applications received after 5:00 PM on 04.12.2026 will not be accepted. As of 21 November 2026, the application period is still open.

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Thiruvarur Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 59 vacancies for one post. The notice also states that the number of posts is subject to change.

content_sections.text: Take the application form for the post of Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse, printed in the notice under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu and the District Health Society, Thiruvarur heading. Enter the details asked: name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, qualification, institution, council registration number, addresses, Aadhar number, phone number, email ID (if available) and community. Fill in the SSLC and HSC (+2) marks, the percentage in the qualifying exam, and the district(s) applied for (maximum 3). Answer whether you are differently abled, and whether you are a transgender person, deserted wife, ex-serviceman or destitute widow. Affix a passport size photograph and sign the declaration with place and date. Attach the certificates that support the details given in the form. Applications may be given in person or sent by registered post, speed post or courier, to reach by 5:00 PM on 04.12.2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in District Health Society Thiruvarur?
faq.answer: There are 59 Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse vacancies, and the notice says the number of posts is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Executive Secretary by 5:00 PM on 04.12.2026, and later applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Thiruvarur Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: D.G.N.M. or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government approved Private Nursing College recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, with valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Staff Nurse here?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs.21,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form printed in the notice, attach supporting certificates and send it to the Executive Secretary, District Health Society and District Health Office, Old Government Hospital Campus, Netty Velaikkarar Street, Thiruvarur-610001.

faq.question: Q7. Can I submit the application by post or courier?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice allows submission in person or by registered post, speed post or courier.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu, and services will not be regularised for any reason.

faq.answer: The form has a field for the district(s) applied for, with a maximum of 3.
